title: Election-types registry (data/registries/election-types.json)
description: The election vocabulary: voting systems and the kinds of election, each with what it is and the words the site shows for it.

votingSystems.description: Voting system id (an election bundle's votingSystem) -> what it is.

about.description: What the system is, for the people reading the registry.

name.description: The system in words, as the Elections app says it (systemName); absent, the app shows the id.

transfers.description: The count transfers votes between candidates (surpluses and exclusions), so seats worked out from first preferences alone leave the transfers out: the Elections app says so beside such an estimate (the swingometer). Absent for a system that does not transfer.

electionKinds.description: Kind of election (general, by-election) -> what it is.

listLabel.description: The kind as a list of elections is named (Browse's Type filter).
